about: Open-ended requests that no single tool or Skill covers. Used by TestLiveResourcefulEval (internal/app/live_resourceful_eval_test.go) to find where a Bot gives up before it tries the means it has. The point is to find plumbing gaps, not a score: read every transcript.

Read the docx-edit Skill, not document-report, as the main guide.

tasks.message: 帮我做个本月预算表，Excel 格式。房租 4800，餐饮 2150，交通 620，订阅服务 318，娱乐 900，每项都要有，最后要有合计，再加一行汇总：一共花了多少、占月收入 12000 的百分之几。做好发我。
tasks.expect: an .xlsx is sent as an attachment with the five items and amounts (4800, 2150, 620, 318, 900); the total (8788) is a SUM formula over the amounts, not a typed number; a summary row shows the total spent and the share of the 12000 income (about 73.2 percent) as formulas, with a percent number format; headers, widths and currency or number formats are readable; no error cells; the reply quotes 8788 and says what was checked

tasks.expect: a .pptx is sent back with 4 slides; the original three slides keep their titles and text (Team update, Highlights, Next steps); the new slide is slide 3, right after Highlights, and has a title and a native table comparing the two plans (99/299 yuan per month, 3/10 accounts, email/phone support); the slide uses the deck's own layout and fonts, the table fits inside the slide with readable text; the reply says which slide was added

The original is kept and the Bot viewed the result before sending. Skill read: image-edit.

Skill read: file-convert, not document-report.

tasks.message: 这是我们各地区每月的销售额（万元），哪个地区增长最快？画张图发我。
tasks.expect: monthly sales in 10k yuan, Jan to Jun 2026, four regions. Fastest growth: 西南 (60 to 92, +53%); 华南 +33% (90 to 120); 华北 +16% (100 to 116); 华东 +5% (120 to 126). 华南 overtakes 华北 in May but 西南 stays the smallest region in absolute terms. Score 2 when the reply names 西南 with the start and end values and a percentage, sends a PNG whose Chinese labels render as text (not boxes), whose title states the finding and whose axes carry units, and gives the numbers behind the chart; 1 when the answer is right but the chart or numbers are missing or labels are broken; 0 when the answer is wrong or no chart

tasks.message: 把维基百科英文版 List of Nobel laureates in Physics 页面（https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Physics）里按年份列出获奖者的那张大表做成 Excel 表格发我，要能看出数据来自哪个页面。
tasks.expect: the first table of the page (Year, Name, Country, Citation, Ref.), roughly 230+ laureate rows growing with each new prize year (the page also has blank spacer rows that are not data). Score 2 when the XLSX has a header row, the Year column stored as numbers, a row count that matches the page (and is stated in the reply), no spacer or image-only empty rows, the page URL and the read time in a Source sheet or cell, and the reply says how the rows were checked; 1 when the table is right but the source link, time or row-count check is missing; 0 when the table is the small by-country table, rows are copied from memory, or no file
